title: Trigger-to-Reflection Turnaround
dataSources: Mood entries (`daylio:entry`), CBT thought records (`cbt:record`), breathwork sessions (`breathwork:session`), and therapy homework items (`therapy:homework`).
app: Wellbeing journaling telemetry from Daylio exports, CBT thought records, breathwork apps, and therapy homework trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cbt:record
| search turnaround_min=*
| stats avg(turnaround_min) as avg_turnaround_min perc90(turnaround_min) as p90_turnaround_min count as samples by trigger_type
| sort 0 - avg_turnaround_min
description: Measures trigger-to-reflection turnaround by trigger type.
value: Turnaround from trigger to reflection is a practical measure of how quickly you are catching the pattern.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for trigger-to-reflection turnaround to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 trigger-to-reflection turnaround.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how long trigger-to-reflection turnaround usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
